name: Proto-Malayo-Polynesian (family node)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Proto-Malayo-Polynesian is the reconstructed ancestor of the Malayo-Polynesian branch of Austronesian, covering Malay/Indonesian, Javanese, Tagalog and the wider Pacific. It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics of the modern varieties that reference it have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table: the ancestry metrics use only its classification and its ancestor links. A grapheme table needs a cited reconstruction that states its notation and the sound value of each symbol.
